name: Worn Diary's page counters scale with cards in memory
notes: Worn Diary's element is NORM and its memory cost is 0, so no lineage patch is needed and materializing via a direct FSM click is free. Three filler cards are pre-seeded into myMemory so ability 0 (put a page counter per card in memory) has a nonzero, predictable result. Ability 1 (REST, banish self: draw a card, only at 10+ page counters) is out of scope for this fixture -- reaching it would require repeating ability 0 ten times or directly patching the counter, and is left for a follow-up.

rulesClauses: [REST]: Put a page counter on CARDNAME for each card in your memory.
